steps.message: Pakistan moved up in the 2026 Environmental Performance Index, but its air quality scores are still low. Starting from the EPI, where within Pakistan did NO2 and PM2.5 change most between 2019 and 2024?

methods.name: Annual change maps
methods.why: Compute quality-filtered annual averages, harmonize grids, subtract 2019 from 2024 and rank increases and decreases separately per pollutant.

methods.name: District and exposure summaries
methods.why: Summarize signed and absolute changes, accounting for population and data coverage.

methods.name: Sensitivity checks
methods.why: Compare seasonal sampling and weather and check uncertainty rather than interpreting a two-year difference as a causal trend.
